row_fix.reason: The program page says the program is invite-only with occasional thematic open calls; the how-to-apply page is where open calls and the current status are published. Monitoring it catches a new open call.

summary: No structured opportunity feed exists. The CRFS program is invite-only; the how-to-apply page states there are currently no thematic open calls and lists only historical (past) open calls with May 15 deadlines. Nothing live to ingest, so the html monitor on the how-to-apply page is the right adapter: it will change-detect when a new thematic open call is posted.

How-to-apply page (/programs/global-foods/how-to-apply/): 'There are not currently any thematic open calls for CRFS funding. Open calls below are historical...'

engine_requirements: None. Use the existing html adapter with url https://www.mcknight.org/programs/global-foods/how-to-apply/. Expect no rows until McKnight posts a new thematic open call; the html adapter then flags the text change and next_deadline will fire if a future labeled date appears.
caveats: Invite-only program: even a live open call is only a thematic one; most grantmaking is by invitation, so the dashboard should not expect regular opportunity rows.
The html adapter stores no opportunity rows, so this funder yields monitoring alerts only.
